subject: How to get finer resolution at micro_global function?

messages.author: 7e3093df97013b0f
messages.subject: How to get finer resolution at micro_global function?
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am using the microclimate model and micro_global function from NicheMapR to get temperatures of the some specific locations in Brazil. However, the database from New et al. (2002) has a wide resolution (10 x 10) of approximately 17 km. I would like to know if there is a way to re-scale to a more finer resolution. I know some R packages can do this. However, since the micro_global database file is in .nc format, I can not do this kind of processing.

I will glad for your help.

Arielson

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: How to get finer resolution at micro_global function?
parts:
Hi Arielson,
You can specify the elevation and a lapse-rate correction will be applied to temperature (making the requisite adjustment to relative humidity) but, other than that, you'd have to directly process the New et al data outside of NicheMapR.
All the best,
Mike
